name: Home relay
short_desc: Door intercom and camera relay for the Home app: rings, pushes, live video and talk.
author: Florian Geymayer
description: Relay for the Home app (Android, iOS) next to Home Assistant: watches the door station, sends the ring pushes, serves camera pictures and brings live video and talk to the phones through go2rtc. It has no web interface; open the Home app, go to Settings, Kameras & Klingel, and enter the app's domain.

form_fields.label: Home Assistant address
form_fields.hint: Home Assistant as this server reaches it on the home network. Used only when a phone pairs.

form_fields.label: Address of this server for the phones
form_fields.hint: The LAN address (or WireGuard address) the phones reach this server on, for live video and talk on port 8555/tcp.

form_fields.label: APNs key id
form_fields.hint: iPhone pushes. The .p8 key itself goes into the data folder as apns-key.p8, see the description.

form_fields.label: Apple team id
form_fields.hint: iPhone pushes, together with the APNs key id.
